Name: Nyapu-Style Homewrecker Lance Portrait Replacer (plus TFC and BTAS recolors)
Author: auqustfire
Description:
Sorry for the terrible title image, I am not a graphic designer. When I unlock him in game (or if someone else provides images) i'll add some in-game screenshots.

[center][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/center]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I edited Nyapu's original Lance portrait to match the design of FreakyBiscuit1's Homewrecker Lance. I really love that design, but I wanted to use it with Nyapu's portraits, since that's my preferred portrait replacer. I thought it turned out well, so I decided to release it as a mod, in case anyone else might want to try it out! I got permission from FreakyBiscuit1 and Nyapu has open permissions on their portraits, so hopefully this will be ok. I'm also pretty sure that recolors are alright for TFC and BTAS?[/color][/size]

[center][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/center]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Manual installation, since these are just meant to replace the portraits in the original mods. Extract the files, take the [CP] Homewrecker Lance folder and copy and paste it into your mod folder. Assuming I got the file structure right, it should ask to overwrite several files. Hit yes and then it should be installed! Check in the Portraits folder and make sure they've been replaced. If they didn't, let me know, haha, but you can also just grab the images from the Portraits folder in this mod and copy and paste them in the Portraits folder in your Homewrecker Lance mod folder.

It's the same with the Farmer's Children and Babies Take After Spouses recolors, they'll replace the images in those mod's folders.

[/color][/size]
[center][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]NOTE FOR THE FARMER'S CHILDREN:[/b][/color][/size][/center]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The file structure is setup to replace Lance's children textures in the Deluxe art mod. If you're using the standard or simplified art versions, you'll have to manually replace the textures. I'm personally just using the simplified art mod and put the pieces together myself from the deluxe mod, but I haven't actually got a save with children to test it out. I made these edits so I could have them when I do reach that point, so if someone who has children in game already can test them for me, that'd be great.

[/color][/size]
[center][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]NOTE FOR BABIES TAKE AFTER SPOUSES:[/b][/color][/size][/center]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The original mod doesn't have SVE marriage candidates in it. These recolors default to replace Emily's default skin baby/toddler textures, just because I had no plans to marry her myself, so I didn't mind replacing them. You can change the name of them if you want to replace a different marriage candidate. There's also an extra hairstyle for the girl toddler that I made while playing around. It's in a separate folder, but you can move it from the ExtraHairForGirl folder to the [CP] Babies Take After Spouse v2/assets/Female folder if you want to use it and it will replace Emily's default skin pigtail hair toddler. I haven't tested it, so hopefully it looks alright.[/color][/size]

[center][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/center]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Replaces the portraits in the Homewrecker Lance mod with a modified Nyapu Lance portrait set.

- All of his portraits are replaced (Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter, Beach and Flower Festival) all outfits edited and redrawn to match Homewrecker Lance's design!

- Optional recolors for The Farmer's Children and Babies Take After Spouse v2 so the children match hair, eyes and skin with Homewrecker Lance (these are a separate download so you can just use these if you want). Hair was recolored for the vanilla children (Portraits and sprites) and hair, eyes and skin for the Nyapu-style children in TFC. Babies and toddlers in BTAS are recolored to match his hair, skin and eye color, as well as outfits on the toddlers.[/color][/size]

Downloads.Description: The main mod. Move the [CP] Homewrecker Lance folder within to your Mods folder and let it overwrite the existing Homewrecker Lance folder.
Recolors for the children textures in The Farmer's Children and Babies Take After Spouse v2. Only useful if you're using those mods.
